parameters.query:
-- Recompute Actual Hours per Notion engagement from tt.entry_current.
-- Corrections mark tt.notion_dirty; we always recompute (never increment).
WITH dirty AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT stream_id
  FROM tt.notion_dirty
  WHERE cleared_at IS NULL
  UNION
  -- Also refresh any client stream touched in the last 2 hours
  SELECT DISTINCT stream_id
  FROM tt.time_entry
  WHERE entered_at > now() - interval '2 hours'
    AND stream_id IS NOT NULL
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    s.id AS stream_id,
    s.notion_page_id,
    s.code,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(t.duration_s), 0) / 3600.0, 2) AS actual_hours
  FROM tt.stream s
  LEFT JOIN tt.entry_current t ON t.stream_id = s.id
  WHERE s.kind = 'client'
    AND s.notion_page_id IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      s.id IN (SELECT stream_id FROM dirty WHERE stream_id IS NOT NULL)
      OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tt.notion_dirty LIMIT 1)
    )
  GROUP BY s.id
)
SELECT * FROM totals;

-- Find Notion task pages related to this engagement that carry Actual Hours.
-- Engagement-level roll-up: sum onto a synthetic key stored as stream code in Task Name prefix,
-- OR update all open tasks under the engagement proportionally.
-- Practical approach used here: write the engagement total onto EVERY related task's
-- Actual Hours is wrong. Instead we store the stream total on a dedicated rollup row
-- if one exists (Task Name = 'Hours rollup'), else skip task writes and only clear dirty.
-- Owner: prefer writing Actual Hours on tasks via engagement relation filter in Notion node below.
SELECT
  '{{ $json.notion_page_id }}'::text AS engagement_page_id,
  {{ $json.actual_hours }}::numeric AS actual_hours,
  '{{ $json.stream_id }}'::uuid AS stream_id,
  '{{ $json.code }}'::text AS code;

nodes.name: Tasks for engagement
nodes.notes: Property name 'Engagement' must match the Tasks DB relation. Adjust if the live schema uses a different label.

parameters.query:
UPDATE tt.notion_dirty
SET cleared_at = now()
WHERE stream_id = '{{ $('Recompute hours').item.json.stream_id }}'
  AND cleared_at IS NULL;

meta.notes: Aegis only. Recompute from tt.entry_current — never increment. Corrections reach Notion because dirty periods force a full recompute.
